_comment: Copy this file to standards-editions.json (same directory) to bind issue
and date to the standards a verdict is measured against.
standards-map.yaml carries a designation, a publisher and a gating flag,
but no issue and no date. Until this overlay exists, every entry in a
record is emitted with issue and issue_date explicitly null and
edition_binding 'unbound'. That is a gap someone must close with the
paper in front of them: nothing in this tool will guess a date.
Keys are the standard ids used in standards-map.yaml. issue is the
revision or amendment designation as the publisher writes it; issue_date
is ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the publisher gives only a
month). Leave a key out entirely rather than filling it with a guess -
an absent key reads as 'unbound', an invented date reads as fact.
The overlay file is bound into every record by digest, so a later change
to an edition claim is visible to anyone re-reading an issued dossier.
